question: Should CodexBar define Neuralwatt as a prepaid-balance-only provider, or must it also surface active subscription kWh allowance before merge?
rationale: Both interpretations are technically implementable, but the current choice changes the user-visible meaning of “exhausted” and requires repository-owner acceptance rather than automation judgment.

options.title: Surface both quota pools
options.body: Show active subscription kWh alongside prepaid USD credits so the menu reflects all currently usable Neuralwatt capacity.

options.title: Accept prepaid-only semantics
options.body: Explicitly define the provider as prepaid-balance monitoring only and make the menu and documentation unmistakable that subscription capacity is excluded.

options.title: Pause the integration
options.body: Keep the PR open until a representative subscription account and exact-head proof are available to validate the intended product model.

recommendation.title: Surface both quota pools
recommendation.body: Show active subscription kWh alongside prepaid USD credits so the menu reflects all currently usable Neuralwatt capacity.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the branch hardening and explicitly documented the unresolved product-contract decision.
